candidate.target: About50 earned coins per successful catch; fresh local immediate-sale gross, not a per-fish floor/cap

qualityRule.formula: originalSpeciesWeight * baseScale * (quality=rare ? regionalRareFactor : 1), then add existing equipment bonus and apply existing pity multiplier

method.weights: Uniform weight draw rounded to2dp, enumerated cent-bin probability masses including endpoint half-bins; no Monte Carlo.
method.pity: Regenerative stationary distribution: normalMass=sum(k=0..29)(1-h0)^k, tailMass=(1-h0)^30/h1. Non-fish is a state-independent self-loop.
method.price: Actual market formula and supply table frozen in INPUT_SNAPSHOT; all2400 representative original quote cells cross-checked against quoteFish while source hashes match.
method.precision: Floating-point continuous-uniform expectation with exact game rounding bins. Neglects tiny32-bit RNG quantization; decimals beyond0.001 coin are not a promise.
method.netScenario: Paid-bait comparison assumes all bait bought at120/5fish and all item drops sold; excludes initial free bait and bait-box usage. Marginal bait profitability is not guaranteed.
